name: Higashi-Nakano
tagline: One stop from Shinjuku, without becoming an entertainment district.
summary: The JR Chuo-Sobu Line puts Shinjuku one stop and five minutes away, and the Oedo Line runs direct to Roppongi. Despite being this close to Shinjuku, the area around the station never turned into a nightlife district, so it stays residential in character. The cherry trees along the Kanda River are nearby.
goodFor: People who want to be practically walking distance from Shinjuku
People who do not want to live in an entertainment district
Single people balancing rent against access
notFor: People who want a lot of shopping options
People who want to board at a terminus
residentComment: The value here is that a station one stop from Shinjuku is this calm. It lacks the character of Koenji or Nakano, which is exactly why it is easy to live in. The Oedo Line access is routinely overlooked.
